```{=html}
    <h1>The functional integral</h1>
  </header>
```

::: {.qft-exam-body}
- Consider the functional integral for a scalar field. Formulate the rules for obtaining Feynman diagrams from the generating functional.

- Obtain the expressions for the vacuum energy (the energy density of the zero-point oscillations) and draw the corresponding Feynman diagrams for the $\lambda\phi^4$ model.

- Show that vacuum loops ("bubbles") do not contribute to scattering amplitudes.

- Compute the vacuum energy density for scalar, fermion, and massive and massless vector fields. Write the final expression for the mean vacuum energy density including quantum corrections.

:::
